title: claimYieldFeeShares subtracts the full cached yieldFeeBalance instead of the claimed shares
description: Cross-function state consistency (lens A): yieldFeeBalance is a debt counter read by _totalDebt, totalYieldBalance, availableYieldBalance, liquidatableBalanceOf and transferTokensOut. Its only decrementing writer, claimYieldFeeShares, mints _shares but zeroes the whole balance. After a partial claim the unclaimed fee entitlement leaves totalDebt, so the backing assets become available yield and can be liquidated by the liquidation pair to the prize pool. The fee recipient permanently loses the remainder.

harm.loses_what: unclaimed fee shares left after a partial claim

exploit_trace: 2. yieldFeeRecipient calls claimYieldFeeShares(100): 100 shares minted, yieldFeeBalance set to 0.
3. totalDebt drops by 900 relative to the correct value; 900 assets of backing are now counted as available yield.
4. liquidationPair liquidates that yield; the recipient can never claim the remaining 900.

preconditions.text: yieldFeeBalance > 0 and recipient claims fewer shares than the balance

audit_trail.step_execution: Found by: P1, A, B, C, D (5 sources); Pass 2 lens A: write-set review of yieldFeeBalance

title: convertToShares and maxRedeem revert with division by zero when totalAssets == 0 (ERC4626 non-revert requirement)
description: Confirms DP1-2. When totalAssets()==0 and totalDebt>0, convertToShares calls mulDiv(..., 0) and reverts. maxRedeem for a holder with shares > 0 has _maxWithdraw == 0 so it enters the branch and mulDiv(0, totalDebt, 0, Up) reverts. ERC4626 requires maxRedeem and convertToShares not to revert. convertToAssets and maxWithdraw handle the case, so this is an inconsistency among siblings. Requires total loss in the yield vault (README: not expected).
root_cause: No _totalAssets == 0 guard in the lossy branches of convertToShares/maxRedeem.
recommendation: Handle _totalAssets == 0 (return 0 from maxRedeem; define convertToShares behavior).

harm.loses_what: view calls revert in total-loss state

exploit_trace: 1. Yield vault total loss: totalAssets()==0, totalSupply>0.
2. Call maxRedeem(holder) or convertToShares(x): division by zero revert.

audit_trail.step_execution: Found by: P1, D (2 sources); Lens D: boundary tracing with totalAssets=0

title: yieldFeeRecipient may be address(0); accrued fee shares then become unclaimable and permanently lock yield out of liquidation
description: Edge case (caller/recipient is address(0)): the constructor and setYieldFeeRecipient accept address(0) with no check, unlike every other address parameter (claimer, LP, yieldVault, owner). The factory is permissionless and forwards any _yieldFeeRecipient. With a nonzero yieldFeePercentage, transferTokensOut keeps accruing yieldFeeBalance, which counts as debt, but onlyYieldFeeRecipient can never be satisfied, so that share of yield is never claimable and stays permanently locked until the owner resets the recipient.
recommendation: Revert on address(0) when yieldFeePercentage > 0, or in general.

harm.loses_what: yield fee accrued while recipient is zero is stuck until owner fixes it

exploit_trace: 1. Vault deployed via factory with _yieldFeeRecipient = address(0) and yieldFeePercentage > 0.
3. No address can call claimYieldFeeShares; the fee assets stay locked as debt.

preconditions.text: deployer or owner sets zero recipient
